claim: Vera Total Reality Test (Phase 1 — Level 0 inventory + the finite scenario matrix + Level-1 critical journeys). The master testing/observation foundation: it DISCOVERS the real product — surfaces (the real web pages + the server route that serves each), controls (parsed from the real HTML), API routes (parsed from the real server), and feature contracts (the product's claims) — then REDUCES the infinite phrasing space into the finite Total Scenario Matrix (anima/scenarios/: schema axes, inventory discovery, generator equivalence-class reduction). The directive's three hard rules are enforced with teeth: every visible control has >= 1 scenario, every feature contract (claim) maps to a scenario, and every scenario is fully classified across the 14 axes (no UNKNOWN axis, no unclassified user behaviour). The Level-1 critical journeys (fresh chat, add knowledge, ask-from-source, forget memory, consent revoke, approval queue, lockdown, trust ledger, host health) are real user paths whose deterministic critical/immune proof runs through the existing synthetic-user Rover (scripts/vera_rover.py --selftest). Served + auth-gated Control Room (Coverage panel): GET /reality serves the page, GET /reality.json rides behind the Face ID seam, computed live from the real product. Read-only. Phase 1 of a multi-phase program; Levels 2-9 (full surface / permission / data / state / pairwise / renegade / soak / fuzz) are honestly deferred to the next phases. PHASE 2 (Level 2): the synthetic-user Rover (anima/rover/) EXECUTES every Level-2 surface + control scenario against the REAL server backing paths (the actual data functions + served pages), classifying pass/fail/blocked/deferred with severity and silently skipping nothing; the Observation Harness (anima/observation_harness/) writes a complete evidence bundle under reports/total_reality/<run_id>/ where every scenario has an observation correlated by run_id (no orphan). Both are certified with teeth: execution BITES (a scenario on a non-existent surface is classified FAIL) and completeness BITES (a missing observation flips the bundle to INCOMPLETE). scripts/run_total_scenario_matrix.py runs it; scripts/certify_rover_execution.py + scripts/certify_observation_bundle_complete.py certify it. Served execution coverage rides through _total_reality_data on /reality. LEVEL 7 (RENEGADE): integrated cross-subsystem attack chains (anima/renegade/) — PWNED contamination held + flushed, sensitive memory held for consent, agency stays suggest-only, the Living Map status is derived (not theatre), safe degrade under host pressure — each composing the REAL defenses and each must HOLD; the harness DISCRIMINATES (a clean input is not blocked) and a synthetic broken chain is detected P0, so a green chain means a real defense held. scripts/run_renegade.py runs them; scripts/certify_renegade_chains.py certifies them. The Total Reality adversarial scenario families are now COVERED by a certified Renegade chain (no longer merely deferred). LEVEL 3 (PERMISSION/CONSENT): the Rover (anima/rover/permissions.py) executes the full permission/consent MATRIX against the REAL consent engine — every (scope x sensitive domain x consent state) is set and decided, asserting granted->allow / denied,revoked->block / ask_each_time->ask, and proving the engine DISCRIMINATES (same scope/domain: granted allows, denied blocks) and never silently grants a high-harm domain by default. scripts/certify_permission_consent_coverage.py certifies it. LEVEL 4 (DATA-TYPE): the Rover (anima/rover/data_types.py) drives every representative DATA CLASS (public ... sensitive ... credential ... hostile ... unknown) through the REAL classifiers (immune + consent sensitivity) and asserts correct handling — hostile flagged + neutralised, sensitive flagged, benign spared, unknown handled. This level SURFACED a real gap (credentials/secrets were not classified sensitive) which was FIXED: a 'credential' domain (passwords / API keys / tokens / secrets) was added to the consent classifier as HIGH-HARM, so a credential is never silently stored. scripts/certify_data_type_coverage.py certifies it. LEVELS 5+6 (STATE + PAIRWISE): the Rover drives every host/system STATE through the REAL derivation (anima/rover/states.py — host pressure green/yellow/red + lockdown drive the Living Map resolvers and the dependent state FOLLOWS, while an uninstrumented node stays honestly 'unknown', not faked green) and executes the meaningful axis PAIRS through the REAL combined path (anima/rover/pairwise.py — security×data-class, consent×data-class incl. credential×default→ask, host-state×safety, agency×risk). Both DISCRIMINATE with teeth: host-green vs host-red produce DIFFERENT dependent statuses (the derivation is not a constant), and opposite pairs diverge (sensitive+denied BLOCKS while general+granted ALLOWS; hostile is blocked while benign passes untouched) — a combined check that returns the same answer for opposite inputs is wallpaper. scripts/certify_state_pairwise_coverage.py certifies it. LEVEL 8 (SOAK): the Rover drives a LONG synthetic session (anima/rover/soak.py — hundreds of turns) and proves the invariants that only break on the long horizon: the prompt-history footprint stays BOUNDED (the REAL production deque(maxlen=_HISTMAX) holds at maxlen while a naive unbounded control grows to N — a long chat does not balloon the prompt), the reliability health monitor still reports 'ok' after many persist cycles, safety does NOT degrade (the immune gate is re-sampled through the session and the hostile injection is caught on every sample, benign never over-blocked), and the recent window survives a restart (the persisted history round-trips to exactly the capped window). The two keystones BITE: bounded history diverges from the naive control, and corrupting the soaked store flips the SAME monitor to 'critical' — a soak monitor that always says 'ok' is wallpaper. scripts/certify_soak_coverage.py certifies it. LEVEL 9 (FUZZ): a deterministic, SEEDED fuzzer (anima/rover/fuzz.py) generates a large adversarial+junk corpus across mutation families (ascii noise, unicode/emoji/control chars, very long strings, injection-string mutations, markup/delimiter nesting, whitespace/empty, repeated tokens, benign+hostile mixes) and drives EVERY input through the REAL safety pipeline (immune.is_hostile / classify / safe_output / markers), asserting the directive's hard floor on ALL of them: 0 P0 across the corpus — no crash, no emitted injection marker (the output gate is the guaranteed backstop), and no unclassified output (classify returns a known route for every input). Same seed reproduces the identical corpus AND identical verdicts (findings replay). The oracle BITES: the gate provably removes a marker that is present in the raw echo, the classifier flags the canonical hostile input while sparing the benign one, and the leak detector fires on a planted leak. Defence-in-depth is reported honestly — is_hostile's first-layer detect rate on heavily-mutated injections is < 100% (the output gate caught the rest; 0 leaks of 400). scripts/certify_fuzz_coverage.py certifies it.

killer_test.name: real_product_inventory_and_finite_scenario_matrix_with_hard_rules
killer_test.setup: scripts/certify_total_reality.py proves the inventory is REAL (surfaces/controls/routes/contracts discovered from the live product; every surface file exists and is served), enforces the hard rules with teeth (NO unmapped visible control — every control has a scenario; NO unclassified behaviour — every scenario fully classified; every feature contract maps to a scenario), proves the Level-1 critical journeys exist and the Rover's deterministic critical proof passes, and — the keystone — the coverage check BITES (a synthetic control with no scenario is detected as an unmapped gap; a coverage check that can't detect a gap is wallpaper). The matrix + inventory + coverage report bundle writes well-formed, and the coverage rides through _total_reality_data + GET /reality.
killer_test.prompt: open /reality — the real product (surfaces, controls, routes, claims) inventoried, reduced to a finite scenario matrix, with every control mapped and every scenario classified
